analyst_view.overall: Early view: Granada under Pacheta had won five league games in a row (15 of 15 points) going into November, with efficient counter-attacks rather than control of the ball. Girona under Quique Álvarez score freely at Montilivi but have been missing Bryan Gil, Javi Boñar and Jastin García with no return dates given, and lost at Real Sociedad B after an early red card. The numbers favour Girona, but Granada's form makes this closer than that.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Granada win tight games and Girona have both a strong attack and a shaky defence, so I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.4 corners. Granada are happy without the ball, which keeps corner counts down, and that is already in the figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards. Nothing in the news points either way and the referee is not known yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.9 shots. Granada beat Eldense with only 8 shots and let opponents have the ball, so I lean slightly lower on total shots.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. Granada make few but good chances and Girona create a lot, so I stay with the number.
